title: 应天长
author: 周邦彦
note: 【应天长】周邦彦所作的词。【周邦彦】周邦彦（1056—1121），字美成，号清真居士，钱塘人。北宋末期词坛大家，精通音律，创造了许多新词调，词风浑厚和雅、富
tr: 条风布暖，霏雾弄晴，池塘遍满春色。正是夜堂无月，沈沈暗寒食。梁间燕，前社客。似笑我、闭门愁寂。乱花过，隔院芸香，满地狼藉。长记那回时，邂逅相逢，郊外驻油壁。又见汉宫传烛，飞烟五候宅。青青草，迷路陌。强带酒，细寻前迹。市桥远，柳下人家，犹自相识。
appr: 《应天长》是宋代周邦彦的一首词，词作长短句错落，音韵婉转，善于抒写幽微深挚的情感。开篇以“条风布暖”起笔，直陈情境，开门见山切入主题，为全篇奠定情感基调。明月意象的运用尤为出色，月色清辉贯穿全篇，既是写景，也寄托了诗人的情思。诗中以酒寄意，杯酒之中蕴含深厚情感。结句以“犹自相识”收束全篇，点明题旨、呼应开篇，情韵悠长，给读者留下无尽回味。整首词语言凝练、意境深远，充分体现了周邦彦词创作的独特艺术风貌。
st:
【起】开篇“条风布暖”，起笔入题，勾勒场景、渲染氛围，定下全词情感基调。
【承】“似笑我、闭门愁寂”一句承接铺叙，层层延展，将情境与情绪推进深化。
【转】至“飞烟五候宅”处笔锋一转，或由今忆昔、或由景入情，词意翻进，情感达到高潮。
【合】结拍“犹自相识”，以景结情或以情结景，收束题旨，余韵不尽，耐人回味。
img:
【明月】月亮意象，清辉普照，寄托思乡怀人之情，亦象征高洁、永恒与孤独。

【花】花意象，既写春色烂漫，也喻繁华易逝、红颜易老。

【柳】杨柳意象，谐音“留”，常用于送别寄意，亦喻春色与离愁。

【酒】杯酒意象，可遣怀消愁，亦用于送别饯行、畅叙友情。

【风】风意象，春风骀荡、秋风萧瑟，是情感的触媒与自然的信使。

这些意象相互交织、彼此呼应，共同构成作品完整的意境体系，使诗人情感表达具象可感、韵味悠长。

theme: 《应天长》是宋代周邦彦的代表作品，全诗即景抒情，通过景物与人事描写寄托词人真挚的人生感慨与情感体验。作品以凝练的语言、鲜明的意象，将真挚情感寄寓于写景、叙事与抒情之中，以“犹自相识”收束，含蓄深沉、韵味悠长，在艺术上达到情景交融的境界，是周邦彦词创作中颇具特色的佳作。
en_body: The east wind spreads its warmth, thin mists play in the clearing sky, and spring brims over every pond. Now in the night hall the moon is gone, the Cold Food Festival lies dark and still. Swallows beneath the beams, old guests from the spring sacrifice, seem to mock me — doors closed, grief-bound, alone. Tangled blossoms drift past, the scent of rue steals from across the yard, petals strewn in disarray. I still remember that time — an unexpected meeting, her lacquered carriage halted outside the town. Again I see candles passed from the Han palace, smoke curling into the lords' five estates. Green, green the grass, obscuring the old paths. Forcing wine upon myself, I trace, inch by inch, the former traces. The market bridge is far, those houses beneath the willows — I think I still remember them.

seem to mock me — doors closed, grief-bound, alone.

the scent of rue steals from across the yard,
petals strewn in disarray.

an unexpected meeting,
her lacquered carriage halted outside the town.

smoke curling into the lords' five estates.

baihua_lines: 池塘里到处都是春天的景色。
正是夜晚厅堂没有月光的时候，
寒食节夜色沉沉，一片昏暗。
是春社之前就归来的旧客。
它们仿佛在嘲笑我、关起门来愁闷孤寂。
她乘坐的油壁车停在郊外。
baihua: 东风送来暖意，薄雾在晴光中飘散，池塘里到处都是春天的景色。正是夜晚厅堂没有月光的时候，寒食节夜色沉沉，一片昏暗。梁上的燕子，是春社之前就归来的旧客。它们仿佛在嘲笑我、关起门来愁闷孤寂。纷乱的落花飘过，隔院飘来芸草的香气，满地都是凋残的花瓣。我总记得那一回，不期而遇地相逢，她乘坐的油壁车停在郊外。又看见汉宫传赐蜡烛，轻烟散入五侯的宅第。青青的芳草，迷失了旧日的小路。勉强携着酒，细细寻访从前的踪迹。市桥已经遥远，柳树下的人家，好像还能认出来。

title: 拜星月慢

en_body: Lush leaves cast a cool shade, a lone flower breathes cold fragrance, spring has changed across the winding isle. With thin wine I chant alone, weary of wandering, like Xiangru of old. I picture her — gazing long behind silk curtains and scented screens, enduring in vain how much of misted masts and wind-tousled sails? Sweet grasses reach the edge of heaven, the paired swallows of the painted hall are left forlorn. I recall the fluting, pale moon over the pear-bloom court. On burnished red paper I idly write my grievance to the east wind. All night the sinking moon and crying cuckoo seem to call the mooring line at Fourth Bridge loose. My homeward heart surges — already past the southern shore. In a clear night dream I chase the whirling scattered petals far. Thousands upon thousands of willow fronds — they cannot shear away this endless spring sorrow.

they cannot shear away this endless spring sorrow.

title: 浪淘沙慢
author: 周邦彦
body: 更醉蹋、千山冷翠飞晴雪。
note: 【浪淘沙慢】周邦彦所作的词。【周邦彦】周邦彦（1056—1121），字美成，号清真居士，钱塘人。北宋末期词坛大家，精通音律，创造了许多新词调，词风浑厚和雅、富
tr: 梦仙到、吹笙路杳，度巘云滑。溪谷冰绡未裂。金铺昼锁乍掣。见竹静、梅深春海阔。有新燕、帘底低说。念汉履无声跨鲸远，年年谢桥月。曲折。折画阑尽日凭热。半蜃起玲珑楼阁畔，缥缈鸿去绝。飞絮扬东风，天外歌阕。睡红醉缬。还是催、寒食看花时节。花下苍苔盛罗袜。银烛短、漏壶易竭。料池柳、不攀春送别。倩玉兔、别捣秋香，更醉蹋、千山冷翠飞晴雪。
appr: 《浪淘沙慢》是宋代周邦彦的一首词，词作长短句错落，音韵婉转，善于抒写幽微深挚的情感。开篇以“梦仙到、吹笙路杳”起笔，直陈情境，开门见山切入主题，为全篇奠定情感基调。明月意象的运用尤为出色，月色清辉贯穿全篇，既是写景，也寄托了诗人的情思。结句以“更醉蹋、千山冷翠飞晴雪”收束全篇，点明题旨、呼应开篇，情韵悠长，给读者留下无尽回味。整首词语言凝练、意境深远，充分体现了周邦彦词创作的独特艺术风貌。

theme: 《浪淘沙慢》是宋代周邦彦的代表作品，全诗即景抒情，通过景物与人事描写寄托词人真挚的人生感慨与情感体验。作品以凝练的语言、鲜明的意象，将真挚情感寄寓于写景、叙事与抒情之中，以“更醉蹋、千山冷翠飞晴雪”收束，含蓄深沉、韵味悠长，在艺术上达到情景交融的境界，是周邦彦词创作中颇具特色的佳作。
en_body: In dream I reach the immortals — the road of sheng-playing is long and faint, clouds slip beneath my feet as I cross the peaks. In the valley the ice-silk has not yet split. The bronze-studded door is pulled open at midday. I find bamboo still, plum blossoms deep, a spring sea stretching wide. New swallows murmur low beneath the curtains. I think of the silent Han shoes, the one who rode a whale far away — year after year only the moon above Xie Bridge remains. Turning, winding through the quiet night. All day I lean against the painted rail, my heart still burning. A mirage rises beside the delicate pavilion, the wild geese vanish into the distant air. Willow catkins toss in the east wind, a song ends beyond the sky. My cheeks flushed from sleep, eyes dazed with wine. Again the season urges — Cold Food, time to view the flowers. Beneath the blooms green moss bears the prints of silk stockings. Silver candles burn low, the water-clock runs dry all too soon. The willow by the pond, I think, will not break a branch to see spring off. Bid the Jade Hare pound fresh autumn incense, then drunk, stride across a thousand cold-green hills where sunlight snow flies.

baihua_lines: 梦里仿佛来到仙乡，吹笙的道路遥远渺茫，
山谷里的冰绡还没有裂开。
金饰的门环在白昼刚被拉开。
看见竹子幽静、梅花深处春海般辽阔。
有新来的燕子，在帘底低声呢喃。
念及汉时的鞋履无声，乘鲸远去的人已远，
年年都空对着谢桥的月亮。
整日倚着曲折的画栏，心中热念。
半空中蜃楼在玲珑的楼阁畔浮起，
缥缈的鸿雁飞去，了无踪迹。
睡时脸上泛着红晕，醉中眼花缭乱。
又到了催促寒食节看花的时节。
花下青苔上印满罗袜的痕迹。
银烛已经烧短，漏壶的水也容易滴尽。
料想池边的柳树，不会折枝为春天送别。
请玉兔另捣秋天的香药，
更醉中踏过千山冷翠，飞起晴日的雪。

小桥外，新涨的绿水溅溅流淌。

来寄居在长长的屋椽下。
且不要去想身外的功名利禄，
还是长久地坐在酒杯前吧。
不忍再听那急促繁密的管弦。
baihua: 春风中莺雏渐渐长大，夏雨把梅子催得肥硕，正午时分嘉树投下清圆的树荫。此地低洼靠近山峦，衣服潮湿，需要多费炉烟来烘干。人境幽静，乌鸦和鹞鹰自得其乐，小桥外，新涨的绿水溅溅流淌。久久倚着栏杆，满眼黄芦苦竹，让人想泛舟九江之上。一年又一年。我就像春社时飞来的燕子，漂流到遥远的瀚海，来寄居在长长的屋椽下。且不要去想身外的功名利禄，还是长久地坐在酒杯前吧。憔悴的江南倦客，不忍再听那急促繁密的管弦。歌筵旁边，先安好竹席和枕头，容我醉了就安睡。
en_lines: The wind has aged the young orioles,
rain plumped the mellow plums,
and fine trees cast round, clear shadows at noon.
The ground is low, the mountains close,
damp clothes drink the hearth-smoke thick.
All is still; crows and kites enjoy themselves,
beyond the little bridge fresh green water gurgles on.
Long I lean upon the rail,
yellow reeds and bitter bamboo all around,
I long to drift a boat down the Jiujiang.
Year after year.
Like the swallows of the spring sacrifice,
I have drifted across vast deserts
to roost beneath another's rafters.
Think no more of things beyond the body —
stay close, stay close, beside the wine.
A weary, haggard stranger south of the river,
I cannot bear the shrill, the rapid strings and pipes.
Beside the singing feast,
lay down the mat, arrange the pillow first,
and let me sleep when I am drunk.

title: 琐窗寒
author: 周邦彦
note: 【琐窗寒】周邦彦所作的词。【周邦彦】周邦彦（1056—1121），字美成，号清真居士，钱塘人。北宋末期词坛大家，精通音律，创造了许多新词调，词风浑厚和雅、富
tr: 驻马林塘，还寻旧迹，雨收秋晚。残蕉映牖，强把碧心偷展。记相逢、画堂宴开，乱花影入帘初卷。正小池涨绿，丝纶曾试，事随鸿远。凄断。情何限。料素扇尘深，怨娥碧浅。清宫丽羽，漫有苔笺题满。问低墙、双柳尚存，几时艳烛亲共剪。但凝眸，数点遥峰，春色青如染。
appr: 《琐窗寒》是宋代周邦彦的一首词，词作长短句错落，音韵婉转，善于抒写幽微深挚的情感。开篇以“驻马林塘”起笔，直陈情境，开门见山切入主题，为全篇奠定情感基调。结句以“春色青如染”收束全篇，点明题旨、呼应开篇，情韵悠长，给读者留下无尽回味。整首词语言凝练、意境深远，充分体现了周邦彦词创作的独特艺术风貌。

【承】“正小池涨绿”一句承接铺叙，层层延展，将情境与情绪推进深化。
【转】至“清宫丽羽”处笔锋一转，或由今忆昔、或由景入情，词意翻进，情感达到高潮。

en_body: I rein my horse at the wooded pond, seeking again the traces of old days, autumn rain has cleared, the evening falls. Tattered plantains glow against the window, forcing their green hearts shyly open. I recall our meeting — the painted hall, the feast laid out, dancing blossom shadows on the newly rolled blind. The small pool had just swelled green, I cast my fishing line there once, but all that has flown with the wild geese. Heartbreak, sharp and cold. How much feeling there remains. I think the white silk fan is deep in dust, the blue of her grieving brows has faded thin. Bright plumes in the quiet palace — in vain I filled the moss-letter paper with verse. I ask: do those twin willows by the low wall still stand? When shall we trim the candle-flame together again? I can only fix my gaze afar — a few distant peaks, their spring green fresh as dyed.

记得当初相逢、画堂上宴席初开，

客人离去后车马扬起的尘埃漠漠一片。

收敛着残余的红光、还眷恋着孤城的栏角。

让我重新解下绣花的马鞍，
不记得归家时是早是晚，
醒来时已睡在朱阁之中。
可叹西园里、已是花深如海不见地面，
还欣喜在这洞天福地自得其乐。
baihua: 郊外的原野静静地环抱着城郭。行路漫长，客人离去后车马扬起的尘埃漠漠一片。斜阳映着山峦缓缓落下。收敛着残余的红光、还眷恋着孤城的栏角。美人轻盈的脚步有些娇弱。经过短亭、哪里需要预先约定。有枝头流莺婉转向我劝酒，让我重新解下绣花的马鞍，慢慢斟上春日的酒。不记得归家时是早是晚，上马时是谁搀扶，醒来时已睡在朱阁之中。狂风掀动帘幕。我扶着残醉，绕着红芍药花徘徊。可叹西园里、已是花深如海不见地面，东风为何又这样凶恶。任凭流光飞逝吧。还欣喜在这洞天福地自得其乐。
en_lines: Quietly the countryside girdles the city walls.
The road is long,
the guest has gone; carriage dust blurs the air.
The slanting sun sinks behind the hills.
Crimson afterglow still lingers on the lone town's parapet.
Her tripping steps are light and faint.
We meet at the short post — no prior tryst arranged.
A wandering oriole urges me
to loosen once more the embroidered saddle
and pour a slow spring cup.
I know not whether I returned early or late,
who helped me to the horse,
only that I woke asleep within the crimson tower.
A sudden gust shakes the curtains.
Still half-drunk, I steady myself
and circle the red peonies.
Alas, the West Garden — flowers are deep now, no ground to be seen,
why must the east wind be cruel again?
Let the flowing light slip by.
I still rejoice in this hidden world, my own delight.

title: 瑞龙吟
author: 周邦彦
note: 【瑞龙吟】周邦彦所作的词。【周邦彦】周邦彦（1056—1121），字美成，号清真居士，钱塘人。北宋末期词坛大家，精通音律，创造了许多新词调，词风浑厚和雅、富
tr: 章台路。还见褪粉梅梢，试花桃树。愔愔坊陌人家，定巢燕子，归来旧处。暗凝伫。因念个人痴小，乍窥门户。侵晨浅约宫黄，障风映袖，盈盈笑语。前度刘郎重到，访邻寻里，同时歌舞。唯有旧家秋娘，声价如故。吟笺赋笔，犹记燕台句。知谁伴，名园露饮，东城闲步。事与孤鸿去。探春尽是，伤离意绪。官柳低金缕。归骑晚，纤纤池塘飞雨。断肠院落，一帘风絮。
appr: 《瑞龙吟》是宋代周邦彦的一首词，词作长短句错落，音韵婉转，善于抒写幽微深挚的情感。开篇以“章台路”起笔，直陈情境，开门见山切入主题，为全篇奠定情感基调。词作以今昔对照手法写重访旧地的感慨，景物依旧而人事全非，缠绵吞吐，极尽婉约之致。结句以“一帘风絮”收束全篇，点明题旨、呼应开篇，情韵悠长，给读者留下无尽回味。整首词语言凝练、意境深远，充分体现了周邦彦词创作的独特艺术风貌。

【承】“障风映袖”一句承接铺叙，层层延展，将情境与情绪推进深化。

en_body: Zhangtai Road stretches out before me now. I see again the plum boughs shed their powder, peach trees tentatively blooming. Hushed the houses of the pleasure lanes, the nest-building swallows returning to their old haunts. I stand in silent, brooding gaze. And I think of her — that delicate young thing, peering shyly from the doorway. At dawn she touched pale palace yellow to her brow, raised her sleeve against the wind, her laughter light and bright. Liu Lang, who came before, returns once more, seeking neighbours, searching lanes, the old haunts of song and dance. Only Qiu Niang of those days keeps still her former fame. On singing paper, with poet's brush, I still recall the Yantai verses. Who accompanies her now, I wonder — drinking openly in famous gardens, strolling idly through the eastern town? All that has gone with a single lonely swan. Seeking spring, I find only the grief of separation. Official willows trail their golden threads. I ride back late, fine rain drifting over the delicate pond. In the heart-breaking courtyard, the blind is filled with wind-tossed catkins.

en_body: Helped onto my horse still half-drunk, the morning wind could not rouse me sober. Green tiles and crimson eaves mirrored in the winding stream, among the hanging willows a ferry post suddenly appears. Once I wrote verses on that weathered wall, now spiderwebs shroud the faded ink, moss-stain blue-green. I think on coming and going — years flow like water, I linger long, sighing, brimful of sorrowful thought. On and on, too weary to ask the road ahead. The old days at Jiangling — have I ever asked after Yang Qiong again? Those old tunes are bleak and cold. She knits her grieving brows — for whom shall she play? If that old friend were here before the wine, it is her longing for me that would move me most. No need for the Weicheng song. Before the singing ends, tears already fall.

如今蛛网笼罩、淡墨间青苔晕成青色。
想到来去之间、岁月如流水般逝去，
徘徊良久、叹息声声愁思满溢。
走了又走，倦于再寻路程。
何曾再去问过杨琼的消息。
她皱着愁眉、又能弹给谁听？
若是酒席上的故人还在眼前，
想念我的那份情意最令人动容。
baihua: 被人扶上马时还带着残醉，早晨的风吹着也没醒酒。水湾旁倒映着翠瓦朱檐，垂杨丛里忽然看见渡口的驿亭。当年我曾在残破的墙壁上题诗，如今蛛网笼罩、淡墨间青苔晕成青色。想到来去之间、岁月如流水般逝去，徘徊良久、叹息声声愁思满溢。走了又走，倦于再寻路程。江陵的旧事，何曾再去问过杨琼的消息。旧日的曲调凄清悲凉。她皱着愁眉、又能弹给谁听？若是酒席上的故人还在眼前，想念我的那份情意最令人动容。何必再唱渭城曲。歌声还没有唱完，泪水已经先零落下来。
en_lines: Helped onto my horse still half-drunk,
the morning wind could not rouse me sober.
Green tiles and crimson eaves mirrored in the winding stream,
among the hanging willows a ferry post suddenly appears.
Once I wrote verses on that weathered wall,
now spiderwebs shroud the faded ink, moss-stain blue-green.
I think on coming and going — years flow like water,
I linger long, sighing, brimful of sorrowful thought.
On and on, too weary to ask the road ahead.
The old days at Jiangling —
have I ever asked after Yang Qiong again?
Those old tunes are bleak and cold.
She knits her grieving brows — for whom shall she play?
If that old friend were here before the wine,
it is her longing for me that would move me most.
No need for the Weicheng song.
Before the singing ends,
tears already fall.

title: 花犯
author: 周邦彦
note: 【花犯】周邦彦所作的词。【周邦彦】周邦彦（1056—1121），字美成，号清真居士，钱塘人。北宋末期词坛大家，精通音律，创造了许多新词调，词风浑厚和雅、富【青苔】深绿色苔藓。
tr: 粉墙低，梅花照眼，依然旧风味。露痕轻缀。疑净洗铅华，无限佳丽。去年胜赏曾孤倚。冰盘同宴喜。更可惜，雪中高树，香篝熏素被。今年对花最匆匆，相逢似有恨，依依愁悴。吟望久，青苔上、旋看飞坠。相将见、脆丸荐酒，人正在、空江烟浪里。但梦想、一枝潇洒，黄昏斜照水。

theme: 《花犯》是宋代周邦彦的代表作品，全诗描绘山水田园的优美风光与宁静生活，表达对自然之美的热爱与归隐田园、淡泊名利的志趣。作品以凝练的语言、鲜明的意象，将真挚情感寄寓于写景、叙事与抒情之中，以“黄昏斜照水”收束，含蓄深沉、韵味悠长，在艺术上达到情景交融的境界，是周邦彦词创作中颇具特色的佳作。
en_body: The whitewashed wall is low, plum blossoms dazzle the eye, still with that same old grace. Traces of dew lightly adorn the petals. As though all powder and paint were washed away, revealing a beauty beyond words. Last year I leaned alone in the finest hour of blossom-viewing, sharing the feast's joy from an ice-cold plate. More's the pity, then — the tall tree in the snow, like a fragrant censer smoking a quilt of white. This year I face the flowers in greatest haste, meeting them, they seem to hold a grudge, lingering sad, haggard with grief. Long I chant and gaze, on the green moss I watch petals whirl and fall. Soon crisp green plums will be served with wine, while I drift on empty river, mist and waves. Only in dream can I behold — one free, proud branch slanting over water in the evening dusk.

revealing a beauty beyond words.

sharing the feast's joy from an ice-cold plate.

the tall tree in the snow,
like a fragrant censer smoking a quilt of white.

meeting them, they seem to hold a grudge,
lingering sad, haggard with grief.
Long I chant and gaze,

baihua_lines: 露水的痕迹轻轻点缀在花瓣上。
令人怀疑是洗尽了铅华脂粉，
去年赏花胜景中我曾独自倚栏。
在冰盘里同享宴会的喜悦。
像香笼熏着洁白的素被。
今年对着梅花最是匆匆，
相逢时梅花似有无限愁恨，
青苔上、旋即看见花瓣飞坠。
不久将会看见、青梅佐酒，
而我正在空阔江面的烟浪之中。
只能在梦里想象、一枝潇洒的梅花，
在黄昏时分斜斜映照着水面。

title: 西河
author: 周邦彦
note: 【西河】周邦彦所作的词。【周邦彦】周邦彦（1056—1121），字美成，号清真居士，钱塘人。北宋末期词坛大家，精通音律，创造了许多新词调，词风浑厚和雅、富
tr: 佳丽地。南朝盛事谁记。山围故国绕清江，髻鬟对起。怒涛寂寞打孤城，风樯遥度天际。断崖树，犹倒倚。莫愁艇子曾系。空馀旧迹郁苍苍，雾沈半垒。夜深月过女墙来，赏心东望淮水。酒旗戏鼓甚处市。想依稀、王谢邻里。燕子不知何世。入寻常、巷陌人家，相对如说兴亡，斜阳里。
appr: 《西河》是宋代周邦彦的一首词，词作长短句错落，音韵婉转，善于抒写幽微深挚的情感。开篇以“佳丽地”起笔，直陈情境，开门见山切入主题，为全篇奠定情感基调。诗人登临古迹，追怀前朝往事，在历史兴亡的感慨中寄寓深沉的现实关怀。结句以“斜阳里”收束全篇，点明题旨、呼应开篇，情韵悠长，给读者留下无尽回味。整首词语言凝练、意境深远，充分体现了周邦彦词创作的独特艺术风貌。
st:
【起】开篇“佳丽地”，起笔入题，勾勒场景、渲染氛围，定下全词情感基调。
【承】“断崖树”一句承接铺叙，层层延展，将情境与情绪推进深化。
【转】至“赏心东望淮水”处笔锋一转，或由今忆昔、或由景入情，词意翻进，情感达到高潮。
【合】结拍“斜阳里”，以景结情或以情结景，收束题旨，余韵不尽，耐人回味。

theme: 《西河》是宋代周邦彦的代表作品，全诗登临古迹，追怀历史，寄托朝代兴亡之慨与借古鉴今之意。作品以凝练的语言、鲜明的意象，将真挚情感寄寓于写景、叙事与抒情之中，以“斜阳里”收束，含蓄深沉、韵味悠长，在艺术上达到情景交融的境界，是周邦彦词创作中颇具特色的佳作。
en_body: A land of beauties. Who remembers the grandeur of the Southern Dynasties? Mountains encircle the old kingdom, a clear river winds about, rising like paired coils of a maiden's hair. Angry tides beat lonely on the lonely wall, wind-filled sails steer far toward the horizon. Trees on the broken cliffs still lean downward, inverted. Mo Chou's small boat was moored here once. Only old traces remain, dense and darkly green, mist sinks over half the battlements. Deep in the night the moon climbs over the parapet, gazing east from Shangxin Pavilion toward the Huai River. Wine flags and opera drums — where is that market now? I dimly recall the Wang and Xie neighbourhoods. The swallows know not what dynasty this is. They fly into common lanes and ordinary homes, and chattering to each other tell of rise and fall, there in the setting sun.

title: 解语花
author: 周邦彦
note: 【解语花】周邦彦所作的词。【周邦彦】周邦彦（1056—1121），字美成，号清真居士，钱塘人。北宋末期词坛大家，精通音律，创造了许多新词调，词风浑厚和雅、富

en_body: The wind melts flame of the candles, dew moistens the festive lanterns. Lights shoot across the flower market. Moon-glow flows on the tiled roofs. Thin clouds scatter, the White Goddess seems about to descend in her radiance. Her garments pale and elegant. See the Chu maiden — her waist slender as a hand's grasp. Flutes and drums resound, shadows of people stir, dense and sparse, the whole road breathes of musk. And I recall the capital's Lantern Festival night. Thousand gates bright as day, laughter and strolling revelry. Jewelled carriages, silk scarves waving. Where they met, dark dust rose, of course, behind the horses. The season is still the same. Only I find — old passion has faded and waned. The water-clock moves on, my carriage flies back, let the dances end, let the songs cease.

title: 解连环
author: 周邦彦
note: 【解连环】周邦彦所作的词。【周邦彦】周邦彦（1056—1121），字美成，号清真居士，钱塘人。北宋末期词坛大家，精通音律，创造了许多新词调，词风浑厚和雅、富
tr: 怨怀无托。嗟情人断绝，信音辽邈。信妙手、能解连环，似风散雨收，雾轻云薄。燕子楼空，暗尘锁、一床弦索。想移根换叶。尽是旧时，手种红药。汀洲渐生杜若。料舟依岸曲，人在天角。谩记得、当日音书，把闲语闲言，待总烧却。水驿春回，望寄我、江南梅萼。拚今生，对花对酒，为伊落泪。

en_body: A grieving heart has nowhere to rest. Alas — my love has cut me off, letters and word distant and faint. Though a skilled hand might unlink the interlocking rings, it would be as when wind scatters and rain stops, mist light, clouds thin. The Swallow Tower stands empty, dark dust seals the strings upon the bed. I think of flowers transplanted, roots shifted, leaves changed — all of them are from old days, the red peonies she planted with her own hands. On the sandbar, sweet pollia gradually grows. I think her boat must hug the curving shore, she is at the far edge of heaven now. In vain I remember the letters of those days, idle words and empty phrases — I mean to burn them all at last. At the river post spring returns, and I hope she sends me a plum from the south. I would stake all this life, facing flowers, facing wine, to shed tears for her.

en_body: The clear moon bathes the world in water, leaves rustle in the cool breeze, the sound of horses in the lane has just fallen still. Idly we leaned on the dewy well-curb, laughing, swatting gliding fireflies, tearing the delicate painted-silk fan. All quiet, long I lean on the railing late at night, grief keeps me from my bed, I stand until the night-watch arrow is spent. tr: 新绿小池塘。风帘动，碎影舞斜阳。羡金屋去来，旧时巢燕，土花缭绕，前度莓墙。绣阁凤帏深几许，曾听得理丝簧。欲说又休，虑乖芳信，未歌先咽，愁近清觞。遥知新妆了，开朱户，应自待月西厢。最苦梦魂，今宵不到伊行。问甚时说与，佳音密耗，寄将秦镜，偷换韩香。天便教人，霎时厮见何妨。
appr: 《风流子》是宋代周邦彦的一首词，词作长短句错落，音韵婉转，善于抒写幽微深挚的情感。开篇以“新绿小池塘”起笔，直陈情境，开门见山切入主题，为全篇奠定情感基调。词作以今昔对照手法写重访旧地的感慨，景物依旧而人事全非，缠绵吞吐，极尽婉约之致。结句以“霎时厮见何妨”收束全篇，点明题旨、呼应开篇，情韵悠长，给读者留下无尽回味。整首词语言凝练、意境深远，充分体现了周邦彦词创作的独特艺术风貌。

【承】“曾听得理丝簧”一句承接铺叙，层层延展，将情境与情绪推进深化。

【花】花意象，既写春色烂漫，也喻繁华易逝、红颜易老。

【燕】燕子意象，春归秋去，象征春光、重逢与物是人非。

【梦】梦境意象，写往事如烟、理想幻灭、相思恍惚，虚实相生。

bg: 《风流子》为宋代周邦彦所作。周邦彦（1056—1121），字美成，号清真居士，钱塘人。北宋末期词坛大家，精通音律，创造了许多新词调，词风浑厚和雅、富艳精工，被尊为婉约派集大成者。这首词为周邦彦重访旧游之地、追怀往昔情缘之作，写得委婉缠绵，是婉约词代表作品。
theme: 《风流子》是宋代周邦彦的代表作品，全诗通过重访旧地、追忆旧欢，抒发今昔之感、物是人非的怅惘与旧情难忘的缠绵。作品以凝练的语言、鲜明的意象，将真挚情感寄寓于写景、叙事与抒情之中，以“霎时厮见何妨”收束，含蓄深沉、韵味悠长，在艺术上达到情景交融的境界，是周邦彦词创作中颇具特色的佳作。
en_body: New green fills the little pond. Wind stirs the curtain, fine shadows dance in the slanting sun. How I envy those that come and go from the golden chamber — the swallows that nested there in old days, moss that winds and creeps across that wall of berry-green I knew before. How deep within the embroidered curtains and phoenix drapes? I once heard the playing of silk strings there. About to speak, she stops, fearing to break a tender promise, before the song her throat constricts, grief draws near the clear wine cup. Far off I know she has just finished dressing, opening the crimson door, waiting for the moon by the west chamber, as once by Cui Yingying. Bitterest of all — the dream-soul cannot reach her side tonight. Oh, when can I tell her, send sweet news, a secret message, post the mirror of Qin Jia, steal the fragrance of Han Shou? Heaven — if only you would let us meet, if but for an instant — what harm?

title: 钗头凤
author: 唐婉
note: 【钗头凤】唐婉所作的词。【唐婉】唐婉，南宋越州山阴人，陆游前妻，因陆母不满被迫离异，其《钗头凤》为唱和陆游之作，凄婉动人。

en_body: The ways of the world are thin, the hearts of men cruel, rain escorts the dusk, and blossoms fall so easily. The morning wind dries tear-tracks, yet stains of tears remain. Longing to write down what is in my heart, I lean upon the rail and speak to myself. So hard, so hard to bear this cruel fate. Hard, so hard to speak the bitter truth. All is impossibly hard to say or do! We are now each other's strangers, today is nothing like yesterday, my sick soul sways like a swing-rope, unsteady. The horn sounds cold, the night draws to its close. Afraid of being asked, I swallow tears and force a smile. I must hide it, I hide it, I must hide it from all eyes, go on hiding it!

title: 紫萸香慢
author: 姚云文
body: 向尊前、又忆洒酒插花人。
note: 【紫萸香慢】姚云文所作的词。【姚云文】姚云文，字圣瑞，高安人。宋末元初词人，入元后授承直郎。作品通过精炼的语言描绘了典型情境，表达了作者深厚的情感。
tr: 近重阳、偏多风雨，绝怜此日暄明。问秋香浓未，待携客、出西城。正自羁怀多感，怕荒台高处，更不胜情。向尊前、又忆洒酒插花人。只座上、已无老兵。凄情。浅醉还醒。愁不肯、与诗平。记长楸走马，雕弓ㄇ柳，前事休评。紫萸一枝传赐，梦谁到、汉家陵。尽乌纱、便随风去，要天知道，华发如此星星。歌罢涕零。

en_body: Near the Double Ninth, so much wind and rain, I cherish this rare day of warm clear light. I ask if autumn's fragrance is full yet, meaning to take my guest out through the west gate. But the traveller's heart is heavy with feeling, afraid to climb the high deserted terrace, unable to bear all that emotion. Before my cup I recall again those who poured wine and wore flowers with me. Only now among the seats — the old companions are gone. Nothing remains but utter desolation. Lightly drunk, I wake again. Sorrow refuses to be stilled by verse. I recall galloping on horseback along the long catalpa avenue, carved bows piercing willow branches, those days — let them not be judged. A sprig of purple dogwood was passed around by imperial gift, in dream, who reaches the Han tombs now? Let my black gauze cap blow off in the wind, I would have heaven know how thick the white stars upon my head have grown. The song ends, and tears stream down.

translation: 近重阳、偏多风雨，绝怜此日暄明。问秋香浓未，待携客、出西城。正自羁怀多感，怕荒台高处，更不胜情。向尊前、又忆洒酒插花人。只座上、已无老兵。凄情。浅醉还醒。愁不肯、与诗平。记长楸走马，雕弓ㄇ柳，前事休评。紫萸一枝传赐，梦谁到、汉家陵。尽乌纱、便随风去，要天知道，华发如此星星。歌罢涕零。

title: 八归
author: 姜夔
note: 【八归】姜夔所作的词。【姜夔】姜夔（约1155—约1221），字尧章，号白石道人，鄱阳人。南宋著名词人、音乐家，终身未仕，游于公卿间。词风清空骚雅，多【琵琶】西域传入的弹拨乐器。【长恨】无穷无尽的遗恨。

en_body: Pink petals drift from fragrant lotus, paulownia sheds its green leaves, the dark rain in the courtyard has just stopped. For no reason I stand facing my shadow, broken-hearted, and see fireflies dim by the bamboo wall, crickets crying sharply on the moss-grown steps. Seeing a guest off I retrace the westward road, and wonder — on the water, who plucks the pipa? Greatest pity of all — these rivers and mountains, all given over to the crying cuckoos. I long regret our meetings were too brief, too soon ended, and now for what must I face the west wind and part again? Cold islets, pale mist, oars move, the figure grows distant, the boat drifting like a leaf in the vast air. I think of Wenjun watching long for me, leaning on bamboo, sorrow in her step, silk stockings gathering dust. When I return — we shall drink together from jade cups, let the pearl curtain fall, and watch the delicate moon at leisure.

tr: 双桨莼波，一蓑松雨，暮愁渐满空阔。呼我盟鸥，翩翩欲下，背人还过木那回归去，荡云雪、孤舟夜发。伤心重见，依约眉山，黛痕低压。采香径里春寒，老子婆娑，自歌谁答？垂虹西望，飘然引去，此兴平生难酒醒波远，正凝想、明珰素袜。如今安在？惟有阑干，伴人一霎。
appr: 《庆宫春》是宋代姜夔的一首词，词作长短句错落，音韵婉转，善于抒写幽微深挚的情感。开篇以“双桨莼波”起笔，直陈情境，开门见山切入主题，为全篇奠定情感基调。诗人将羁旅漂泊之感与对故乡的思念融入景物描写之中，不事雕琢而真情流露。结句以“伴人一霎”收束全篇，点明题旨、呼应开篇，情韵悠长，给读者留下无尽回味。整首词语言凝练、意境深远，充分体现了姜夔词创作的独特艺术风貌。

【起】开篇“双桨莼波”，起笔入题，勾勒场景、渲染氛围，定下全词情感基调。
【承】“荡云雪、孤舟夜发”一句承接铺叙，层层延展，将情境与情绪推进深化。
【转】至“垂虹西望”处笔锋一转，或由今忆昔、或由景入情，词意翻进，情感达到高潮。
【合】结拍“伴人一霎”，以景结情或以情结景，收束题旨，余韵不尽，耐人回味。

en_body: Twin oars stir waters where water-shields float, a straw cloak is draped with pine-borne rain, evening sorrow gradually fills the wide expanse. I call to my covenant gulls, they flutter down as if to land, then turn away and skim past the tre That time when we went back, cleaving cloud and snow, the lone boat setting out at night. It wounds the heart to see it all again, faintly the eyebrow-shaped mountains appear, a dark blue line pressed low. Spring chill lies on the Incense-Picking Path, the old man dances, swaying, singing alone — who will answer? Westward I gaze toward Rainbow Bridge, and drift lightly away, a joy like this in a lifetime is har Wine fades, waves sound far off, I fix my thoughts — on her bright pearl earrings and white silk stockings. Where is she now? Only the railing keeps me company for a moment.

title: 念奴娇
author: 姜夔

en_body: Through red bloom in full riot a small boat glides, I remember coming — paired with mandarin ducks. Thirty-six pools where no traveller has been, lotus clad in water pendants and wind robes beyond all count. Cool breath blows from the emerald leaves, her jade-like face sobering from wine, a fine rain drifts over reeds and rushes. She smiles sweetly, sways, and cold fragrance flies up into my verse. 记得来时、曾与鸳鸯结伴同游。

水佩风裳般的荷花无数。

tr: 淮左名都，竹西佳处，解鞍少驻初程。过春风十里，尽荠麦青青。自胡马窥江去后，废池乔木，犹厌言兵。渐黄昏，清角吹寒，都在空城。杜郎俊赏，算而今，重到须惊。纵豆蔻词工，青楼梦好，难赋深情。二十四桥仍在，波心荡、冷月无声。念桥边红药，年年知为谁生。
appr: 《扬州慢》是宋代姜夔的一首词，词作长短句错落，音韵婉转，善于抒写幽微深挚的情感。开篇以“淮左名都”起笔，直陈情境，开门见山切入主题，为全篇奠定情感基调。全诗托物起兴，以红豆寄托相思，语言朴素自然，含蓄深沉，成为歌咏相思的千古名篇。结句以“年年知为谁生”收束全篇，点明题旨、呼应开篇，情韵悠长，给读者留下无尽回味。整首词语言凝练、意境深远，充分体现了姜夔词创作的独特艺术风貌。

theme: 《扬州慢》是宋代姜夔的代表作品，全诗细腻刻画爱情的悲欢离合与相思之情，表现深婉真挚的情感世界。作品以凝练的语言、鲜明的意象，将真挚情感寄寓于写景、叙事与抒情之中，以“年年知为谁生”收束，含蓄深沉、韵味悠长，在艺术上达到情景交融的境界，是姜夔词创作中颇具特色的佳作。
en_body: The famed city east of the Huai, the fair place where Bamboo West Pavilion stands, I loosen my saddle and pause — here my journey first rests. Passing through what was once ten li of spring breeze, I find nothing but wild green shepherd's purse. Since the barbarian horses peered across the river and withdrew, the wasted ponds and surviving trees still loathe to speak of war. Gradually dusk comes on, the clear horn breathes out cold, echoing through the empty city. Du Mu once came here, gallant in appreciation, I reckon if today he returned, he would be shocked. Even with his cardamom verses, finely wrought, and blue-mansion dreams so sweet, he could not plumb this depth of grief. The Twenty-Four Bridges are still there, the water's heart sways — a cold moon, silent. I think of the red peonies beside the bridge, year after year — for whom do they bloom?

baihua_lines: 竹西亭所在的美好地方，
解下马鞍稍作停留，这是最初的行程。
走过昔日春风十里的扬州路，
自从胡马窥伺长江离去之后，
荒废的池塘和残存的乔木，
都在空荡荡的城池中回荡。
纵然他豆蔻词写得工巧，
波心摇荡、冷月悄无声息。
年复一年到底是为谁开放。
baihua: 淮水东面的著名都城，竹西亭所在的美好地方，解下马鞍稍作停留，这是最初的行程。走过昔日春风十里的扬州路，全是青青的荠麦野草。自从胡马窥伺长江离去之后，荒废的池塘和残存的乔木，至今还厌恶谈起战争。渐渐到了黄昏，清越的号角吹出寒意，都在空荡荡的城池中回荡。杜牧曾俊逸赏游此地，料想如今如果他，重到这里一定会震惊。纵然他豆蔻词写得工巧，青楼美梦做得再好，也难表达深沉的悲痛。二十四桥依然存在，波心摇荡、冷月悄无声息。想那桥边的红芍药花，年复一年到底是为谁开放。

author: 姜夔

title: 杏花天影
author: 姜夔

tr: 绿丝低拂鸳鸯浦，想桃叶，当时唤渡。又将愁眼与春风,待去,倚兰桡更少驻。金陵路，莺吟燕舞。算潮水知人最苦。满汀芳草不成归,日暮,更移舟向甚处？

en_body: Green willows brush low the Mandarin Duck Ford, I think of Peach Leaf, who called the ferry here long ago. Again I give my grief-filled eyes to the spring wind, about to depart, yet I lean on the orchid oar and linger a moment more. On the road to Jinling, orioles sing, swallows dance. I think only the tide knows the depths of human sorrow. Fragrant grass across the isle bars my return, the day grows late, and where next shall I steer my boat?

title: 琵琶仙
author: 姜夔
note: 【琵琶仙】姜夔所作的词。【姜夔】姜夔（约1155—约1221），字尧章，号白石道人，鄱阳人。南宋著名词人、音乐家，终身未仕，游于公卿间。词风清空骚雅，多【阳关】古关名，在今甘肃敦煌西南，出塞必经之地。【琵琶】西域传入的弹拨乐器。【长恨】无穷无尽的遗恨。
tr: 双桨来时，有人似、旧曲桃叶。歌扇轻约飞花，蛾眉正奇绝。春渐远，汀洲自绿，更添了、几声啼鴂。十里扬州，三生杜牧，前事休说。又还是、宫烛分烟，奈愁里匆匆换时节。都把一襟芳思，与空阶榆荚。万缕、藏鸦细柳，为玉尊、起舞回雪。想见西出阳关，故人初别。八 归 姜夔湘中送胡德华芳莲坠粉，疏桐吹绿，庭院暗雨乍歇。无端抱影销魂处，还见篠墙萤暗，藓阶蛩切。送客重寻西去路，问水面、琵琶谁拔？最可惜一片江山，总付与啼长恨相逢未款，而今何事，又对西风离别？渚寒烟淡，棹移人远，漂渺行舟如叶。想文君望久，倚竹愁生步罗袜。归来后翠尊双饮,下了珠帘,玲珑闲看

en_body: When twin oars approached, someone seemed like — the Peach Leaf of that old song. Her singing fan lightly caught the falling petals, her moth-eyebrows were of unearthly beauty. Spring is gradually receding, along the sandbanks where the reeds grow tall. bar greens on its own, adding a few more cuckoo cries. Ten li of Yangzhou road, Du Mu of three lives, old matters — speak no more of them. Again it is — the Cold Food season of palace candles and shared smoke, but sorrowfully the season has changed too soon. All the tender longing in my breast is given over to elm seeds on the empty steps. Thousands of fine willow strands that shelter crows, dance for the jade cup — like whirling snow in wind. I see in my mind the westward pass at Yangguan, when old friends first parted. Ba Gui — Jiang Kui Sending Hu Dehua off in Xiangzhong Pink petals fall from fragrant lotus, sparse paulownia sheds green leaves, dark rain in the courtyard has just stopped. title: 疏影
author: 姜夔
note: 【疏影】姜夔所作的词。【姜夔】姜夔（约1155—约1221），字尧章，号白石道人，鄱阳人。南宋著名词人、音乐家，终身未仕，游于公卿间。词风清空骚雅，多
tr: 苔枝缀玉。有翠禽小小，枝上同宿。客里相逢，篱角黄昏，无言自倚修竹。昭君不惯胡沙远，但暗忆、江南江北。想佩环、月夜归来，化作此花幽独。犹记深宫旧事，那人正睡里，飞近蛾绿。莫似春风，不管盈盈，早与安排金屋。还教一片随波去，又却怨、玉龙哀曲。等恁时、重觅幽香，已入小窗横幅。
appr: 《疏影》是宋代姜夔的一首词，词作长短句错落，音韵婉转，善于抒写幽微深挚的情感。开篇以“苔枝缀玉”起笔，直陈情境，开门见山切入主题，为全篇奠定情感基调。诗人以细腻笔触描摹自然景物，动静结合、声色兼备，在山水田园中寄托淡泊自适之志。结句以“已入小窗横幅”收束全篇，点明题旨、呼应开篇，情韵悠长，给读者留下无尽回味。整首词语言凝练、意境深远，充分体现了姜夔词创作的独特艺术风貌。
st:
【起】开篇“苔枝缀玉”，起笔入题，勾勒场景、渲染氛围，定下全词情感基调。
【承】“昭君不惯胡沙远”一句承接铺叙，层层延展，将情境与情绪推进深化。
【转】至“莫似春风”处笔锋一转，或由今忆昔、或由景入情，词意翻进，情感达到高潮。
【合】结拍“已入小窗横幅”，以景结情或以情结景，收束题旨，余韵不尽，耐人回味。

en_body: Mossy branches are strung with jade-white blossoms. A pair of small kingfisher birds roost together on the bough. Meeting while a stranger far from home, at dusk by the corner of the fence, she leans wordless and alone on tall bamboo. Zhaojun could not bear the far Tartar sands, and secretly longed for — north and south of the Yangzi, her homeland. I think her jade pendants chiming, her soul returning by moonlight, transformed into this lone, secluded flower. I still recall an old tale from the inner palace, that princess in her sleep, a blossom alighting on her moth-brow green ornament. Do not be like the spring wind, which heeds not all this delicate grace, but early prepares a golden house to hoard it. Let one petal drift away with the current, then grieve — as the jade flute plays its mournful tune. By then, if you seek that faint fragrance again, it will have flown onto a scroll before the small window.

en_body: Cold moonlight over the frontier sands, dust light on the palisade fence, this year the imperial drinking-feast was first bestowed. Newly arranged frontier melodies, heard from felt tents — the marshal's songs and pipes. Storeyed towers soar aloft. See red windings along the curving rails, flying eaves tipped in kingfisher green. There stands a lady of surpassing loveliness. Powdered fragrance drifts down on the breeze, night cold, the wind thin. This place holds all my dearest memories. surely it deserves an immortal poet, riding white clouds and yellow crane, to wander here at play with you. Long I gaze from the jade stair, sighing at the fragrant grass, lush for a thousand li. The taste of being a wanderer at world's end. Using wine to wash away pure grief, watching flowers wear down heroic spirit. Beyond the western hills. When evening comes the blind is rolled up, revealing a curtain of cleared autumn sky after rain.

author: 姜夔

en_body: Light as a swallow, soft as an oriole's call, clear as day I met you again in the dream of Huaxu. The night is long — how should the faithless know? Early spring was already dyed with longing. Letters written after we parted, the clothes sewn as we parted, my parting soul in secret follows you, beloved, far away. The bright moon south of the Huai chills a thousand hills, back into the dark you go, untended and alone.

en_body: Gradually the wind blows away — all fragrant catkins on the boughs. Houses here and there, green shade deep at every door. The distant shore winds and turns, evening sails in disarray — who knows where they are bound? I have seen many people pass, who can compare with — the willows at the Long Pavilion? title: 鹧鸪天
author: 姜夔
note: 【鹧鸪天】姜夔所作的词。【姜夔】姜夔（约1155—约1221），字尧章，号白石道人，鄱阳人。南宋著名词人、音乐家，终身未仕，游于公卿间。词风清空骚雅，多

en_body: The Fei River flows east, endlessly. I never should have planted this seed of longing. In dreams she is less clear than in her portrait, and out of dark a mountain bird's cry startles me awake. Spring has not yet turned green, but my temples are already silk-white. In this world, long parting ceases even to feel like sorrow. Who makes us, year on year through red-lantern nights, mourn apart, each silently knowing?

en_body: Yu Xin first intoned his Rhapsody of Sorrow on his own. Then mournfully I heard again — the cricket's private whispering. Dampening bronze door-knockers with dew, moss encroaching on the stone well-curb, all places where its song was heard before. Its mournful sound pleads as if in tears. Just as the lonely wife cannot sleep, rising to seek her shuttle and loom. Screen-like painted mountains winding far, night cold — what mood is hers, alone? At the west window dark rain blows again. For whom does it break off and resume, answering the fulling-block and pestle? Way-stations greet the autumn, detached palaces mourn beneath the moon, holding other countless griefs. In the manner of Bin verse, written casually. Laughing at children by the fence, calling for lanterns to catch crickets — the world's innocent little ones. Write all of this into the zither strings, and each note grows more bitter still.

en_translation: Yu Xin first intoned his Rhapsody of Sorrow on his own.
Then mournfully I heard again — the cricket's private whispering.
Dampening bronze door-knockers with dew,
moss encroaching on the stone well-curb,
all places where its song was heard before.
Its mournful sound pleads as if in tears.
Just as the lonely wife cannot sleep,
rising to seek her shuttle and loom.
Screen-like painted mountains winding far,
night cold — what mood is hers, alone?
At the west window dark rain blows again.
For whom does it break off and resume,
answering the fulling-block and pestle?
Way-stations greet the autumn,
detached palaces mourn beneath the moon,
holding other countless griefs.
In the manner of Bin verse, written casually.
Laughing at children by the fence, calling for lanterns to catch crickets —
the world's innocent little ones.
Write all of this into the zither strings,
and each note grows more bitter still.

西窗又吹起冷暗的夜雨。
与捣衣的砧杵声相应和。
笑看篱落间呼灯捉蟋蟀的，
baihua: 庾信先是自己吟诵了《愁赋》。凄凄切切又听见了蟋蟀私语般的鸣声。露水沾湿了铜铺门环，青苔侵入石井栏，都是曾经听过它鸣叫的地方。哀怨的声音如泣如诉。正逢思妇无法入眠，起来寻找织布机杼。曲折如画屏的远山，夜凉如水她独自一人是什么情绪。西窗又吹起冷暗的夜雨。为了谁频频断断续续，与捣衣的砧杵声相应和。候馆里迎接着秋意，离宫别院中对月伤吊，另有无数伤心事。像豳诗那样率意成篇。笑看篱落间呼灯捉蟋蟀的，是世间天真的小儿女。把这一切写入琴丝，一声声更加凄苦。

title: 宴山亭
author: 宋徽宗
note: 【宴山亭】宋徽宗所作的词。【宋徽宗】宋徽宗赵佶（1082—1135），神宗第十一子，北宋皇帝，工书善画，创瘦金体，词亦清丽，靖康之变被掳北去，死于五国城。
tr: 裁剪冰绡，轻叠数重，淡著胭脂匀注。新样靓妆，艳溢香融，羞杀蕊珠宫女。易得凋零，更多少无情风雨。愁苦。闲院落凄凉，几番春暮。凭寄离恨重重，这双燕，何曾会人言语。天遥地远，万水千山，知他故宫何处。怎不思量，除梦里有时曾去。无据，和梦也新来不做。
appr: 《宴山亭》是宋代宋徽宗的一首词，词作长短句错落，音韵婉转，善于抒写幽微深挚的情感。开篇以“裁剪冰绡”起笔，直陈情境，开门见山切入主题，为全篇奠定情感基调。诗人以细腻笔触描摹自然景物，动静结合、声色兼备，在山水田园中寄托淡泊自适之志。结句以“和梦也新来不做”收束全篇，点明题旨、呼应开篇，情韵悠长，给读者留下无尽回味。整首词语言凝练、意境深远，充分体现了宋徽宗词创作的独特艺术风貌。

【承】“更多少无情风雨”一句承接铺叙，层层延展，将情境与情绪推进深化。
【转】至“天遥地远”处笔锋一转，或由今忆昔、或由景入情，词意翻进，情感达到高潮。

en_body: As if cut from ice-clear silk, gently layered, fold on fold, an even wash of pale rouge applied. A fresh style of radiant dress, shimmering beauty, melting fragrance, outshaming the nymphs of the Ruby Pearl Palace. Yet it fades so easily, with so much cruel wind and rain to ravage it. Only endless sorrow and bitter weariness. Deserted courtyards stand desolate, how many spring dusks have passed. I would charge these paired swallows to carry my boundless grief, but these two swallows, how could they understand human speech? Sky distant, earth far, ten thousand waters, a thousand mountains, who knows where my palace lies? How could I not long for it, except in dreams — there I sometimes return. But dreams are groundless things, and lately even dreams will not come.

title: 木兰花
author: 宋祁
body: 知我的妻室如何看待我的父母？
note: 【木兰花】宋祁所作的词。【宋祁】宋祁（998—1061），字子京，安陆人。北宋词人、史学家，官至工部尚书，因“红杏枝头春意闹”句被称为“红杏尚书”。
tr: 鳌头可羡，须知富贵非吾愿。雁足难凭，没个音书寄此情。田园荒了，不知松菊犹存否？光景无多，争奈椿萱老去何？自家为父亲所强，来此赴选。谁知逗留在此，竟然不归？今又复拜皇恩，除为议郎。虽则任居清要，争奈父母年老，安可久留他乡？天那！知我的父母安否如何？知我的妻室如何看待我的父母？待自家上表辞官，又未知圣意如何？正是：好似和针吞却线，刺人肠肚系人心。(末丑上唱)。

en_body: To top the exam list is enviable, to be sure, but know this — wealth and rank are not my wish. Wild geese are unreliable messengers, no way to send a letter to convey this feeling. Fields and gardens have gone to waste, I wonder if the pines and chrysanthemums still stand? Time is running short, and what shall I do, with parents grown so old? I was forced by my father to come to the capital for the exam. Who knew I would be stranded here, unable to return? Today once more I receive imperial grace, appointed as Court Gentleman for Consultation. Though the post is pure and prestigious, how can I, with aged parents, stay long in a stranger's land? O Heavens above, why must this be so! I wonder if my mother and father are well? I wonder how my wife treats them in my absence? I mean to submit a memorial resigning office, but I know not what the Emperor's will may be? Truly as the saying goes: it is like swallowing needle and thread together, pricking the gut and tangling the heart. (The Mo and Chou roles enter and sing).

就好像把针线一起吞下肚，
针刺肠肚又牵系着人心。
baihua: 科举高中鳌头确实值得羡慕，要知道富贵并不是我的心愿。大雁传书难以凭信，没有办法寄书信传达这份情意。田园已经荒芜了，不知松树和菊花是否还在？光阴时日已经无多，怎奈父母年事已高如何是好？我自己被父亲强迫，来京城参加考试。谁知却被滞留在这里，竟然无法归去？今日又蒙受皇恩，被任命为议郎。虽然任居清贵显要之职，怎奈父母年老，怎能长久滞留他乡？天哪！不知我的父母是否安康？不知我的妻子如何对待我的父母？等我上表辞官回家，又不知圣上旨意如何？正是常言道：就好像把针线一起吞下肚，针刺肠肚又牵系着人心。（末角、丑角上场唱）。
en_lines: To top the exam list is enviable, to be sure,
but know this — wealth and rank are not my wish.
Wild geese are unreliable messengers,
no way to send a letter to convey this feeling.
Fields and gardens have gone to waste,
I wonder if the pines and chrysanthemums still stand?
Time is running short,
and what shall I do, with parents grown so old?
I was forced by my father
to come to the capital for the exam.
Who knew I would be stranded here,
unable to return?
Today once more I receive imperial grace,
appointed as Court Gentleman for Consultation.
Though the post is pure and prestigious,
how can I, with aged parents,
stay long in a stranger's land?
O Heavens above, why must this be so!
I wonder if my mother and father are well?
I wonder how my wife treats them in my absence?
I mean to submit a memorial resigning office,
but I know not what the Emperor's will may be?
Truly as the saying goes:
it is like swallowing needle and thread together,
pricking the gut and tangling the heart.
(The Mo and Chou roles enter and sing).

title: 小重山
author: 岳飞
note: 【小重山】岳飞所作的词。【岳飞】岳飞（1103—1142），字鹏举，相州汤阴人。南宋抗金名将，被秦桧以“莫须有”罪名杀害。其《满江红》慷慨激昂，是千古传
tr: 昨夜寒蛩不住鸣。惊回千里梦，已三更。起来独自绕阶行。人悄悄，帘外月胧明。白首为功名。旧山松竹老，阻归程。欲将心事付瑶琴。知音少，弦断有谁听。
appr: 《小重山》是宋代岳飞的一首词，词作长短句错落，音韵婉转，善于抒写幽微深挚的情感。开篇以“昨夜寒蛩不住鸣”起笔，直陈情境，开门见山切入主题，为全篇奠定情感基调。诗人以细腻笔触描摹自然景物，动静结合、声色兼备，在山水田园中寄托淡泊自适之志。结句以“弦断有谁听”收束全篇，点明题旨、呼应开篇，情韵悠长，给读者留下无尽回味。整首词语言凝练、意境深远，充分体现了岳飞词创作的独特艺术风貌。

【承】“人悄悄”一句承接铺叙，层层延展，将情境与情绪推进深化。

theme: 《小重山》是宋代岳飞的代表作品，全诗描绘山水田园的优美风光与宁静生活，表达对自然之美的热爱与归隐田园、淡泊名利的志趣。作品以凝练的语言、鲜明的意象，将真挚情感寄寓于写景、叙事与抒情之中，以“弦断有谁听”收束，含蓄深沉、韵味悠长，在艺术上达到情景交融的境界，是岳飞词创作中颇具特色的佳作。
en_body: Last night autumn crickets would not cease their cry. They broke my dream of home a thousand li away, and it was already the third watch. I rose and paced alone around the steps. All the world is hushed in quiet stillness, beyond the blind the moon shone faint and pale. My hair turned white in service of rank and fame. The pines and bamboos of my native hills are old, and the road back is blocked. I would entrust my heart to the jade zither. Those who understand are few, and when the strings break, who will listen?

title: 烛影摇红
author: 廖世美
note: 【烛影摇红】廖世美所作的词。【廖世美】廖世美，北宋末期词人，生平无考，存词甚少。【青苔】深绿色苔藓。
tr: 霭霭春空，画楼森耸凌云渚。紫薇登览最关情，绝妙夸能赋。惆怅相思迟暮，记当日、朱阑共语。塞鸿难问，崖柳何穷，别愁纷絮。催促年光，旧来流水知何处？断肠何必更残阳，极目伤平楚。晚霁波声带雨。悄无人、舟横野渡。数峰江上，芳草天涯，参差烟树。薄 幸 吕滨老青楼春晚，昼寂寂、梳匀又懒。乍听得、鸦啼莺哢，惹起新愁无限。记年时偷掷春心，花前隔雾遥相见。便角枕题诗，宝钗贳酒，共醉青苔深院。怎忘得、回廊下，携手处、花明月满。如今但暮雨，蜂愁蝶恨，小窗闲对芭蕉展。却谁拘管？尽无言、闲品秦筝，泪满参差雁。腰肢渐小，心与杨花共远。

bg: 《烛影摇红》为宋代廖世美所作。廖世美，北宋末期词人，生平无考，存词甚少。这首词借南国红豆寄托相思，清新自然，一往情深，是廖世美五言绝句的名作。
theme: 《烛影摇红》是宋代廖世美的代表作品，全诗细腻刻画爱情的悲欢离合与相思之情，表现深婉真挚的情感世界。作品以凝练的语言、鲜明的意象，将真挚情感寄寓于写景、叙事与抒情之中，以“远”收束，含蓄深沉、韵味悠长，在艺术上达到情景交融的境界，是廖世美词创作中颇具特色的佳作。
en_body: Spring mist fills the air, soft and vast, painted towers rise in solemn majesty to the cloudy isle. Ascending the Ziwei Tower stirs deepest feeling, and finest verses win all praise. Melancholy, longing, until day's the twilight draws its curtain to an end, I recall that day — talking together by the crimson rail. Frontier geese are too hard to question, willows on the bluff stretch without end, parting grief a chaos of catkins. Time hurries, urging us to grow old, the stream that flowed of old — where does it run now? It breaks the heart enough; why add a setting sun? Gazing far, the flat plain wounds the soul. Evening clears, waves carry fine cold autumn rain tapping on the window pane. All quiet, no one — a boat slung across the wild ferry. A few peaks on the river, fragrant grass reaching to the world's end, misty trees uneven in the haze. Bo Xing — Lü Binlao In the blue mansion spring is late, the day is still, she tires of powder and dressing. Suddenly she hears — crows caw, orioles warble, stirring new sorrow without end. She recalls when she was young, stealing a glance of love, meeting him afar through mist before the flowers. Then verses written on the corner pillow, trading her hairpin for wine, drunk together in a deep moss-draped courtyard. How to forget — beneath the winding corridor, hand in hand — bright blossoms, full moon. Now only evening rain, bees grieve, butterflies resent, idly facing the small window, banana leaves unfurling. And who is there to care? Wordless all day, idly strumming the Qin zither, tears falling on its rows of wild-goose frets. Her waist grows smaller day by day, her heart flies with willow catkins she has gone far, far away from me.

baihua_lines: 画楼森然高耸直入云洲。
紫薇省登高览景最是牵动情怀，
暮，此情此景令人心生感慨。
记得当日、朱红栏杆旁共语。
昔日流去的水如今流向何方？
令人断肠，何必再添残阳，
极目望去平野令人伤怀。
雨，此情此景令人心生感慨。
静悄悄无人、小船横在郊野渡头。
数峰江上，诗人借景抒情感怀心绪。
白昼寂寂、梳妆匀粉又慵懒。
忽然听到、乌鸦啼鸣黄莺宛啭，
花前隔着薄雾遥遥相见。
一同醉倒在长满青苔的深院。
尽日无言、闲自品弄秦筝，
泪水流满参差排列的筝雁。
远，此情此景令人心生感慨。

title: 兰陵王
author: 张元干
note: 【兰陵王】张元干所作的词。【张元干】张元干（1091—约1161），字仲宗，号芦川居士，长乐人。南宋初期爱国词人，词风豪迈苍凉，为辛派词人先驱。【朝雨】早晨的雨。
tr: 卷朱箔。朝雨轻阴乍阁。阑干外，烟柳弄晴，芳草侵阶映红药。东风妒花恶。吹落。梢头嫩萼。屏山掩，沈水倦熏，中酒心情怕杯勺。寻思旧京洛。正年少疏狂，歌笑迷著。障泥油壁催梳掠。曾驰道同载，上林携手，灯夜初过早共约。又争信漂泊。寂寞。念行乐。甚粉淡衣襟，音断弦索。琼枝璧月春如昨。怅别后华表，那回双鹤。相思除是，向醉里、暂忘却。

en_body: I roll up the crimson blind. Morning rain and light clouds have just lifted. Beyond the railing, mist-willows dance in clearing light, sweet grass creeps up the steps against red peonies. The east wind, jealous of flowers, is cruel. It blows down petals from the withered boughs, tender buds from the branch tips. Folding screens drawn close, agarwood incense smoulders, weary, and a hung-over heart shrinks from wine cups. I recall the old capital, Luoyang. Then young and wild, lost in song and laughter. Fine horses and lacquered carriages hastened our toilette. We rode together on the imperial road, walked hand in hand through Shanglin Park, and made trysts soon after Lantern Festival ended. How could I have believed I would drift a stranger now? Everything feels so lonely and forlorn. I think of all the pleasures we knew. Powder scent has faded from my robe, letters are broken, strings unstrung. Jade branches and moon-like pearls — spring still as yesterday. Grieving, after parting, before the Huabiao pillar, when will those twin cranes return? This longing — unless I drown it in wine, how can I even briefly forget?

background: 《兰陵王》为宋代张元干所作。宋代诗歌重理趣、好议论，以文为诗，苏轼、黄庭坚、陆游、杨万里等大家辈出；宋词更是一代之文学，婉约豪放各臻其妙。作者张元干在这一时期的创作，多与其人生际遇、时代背景紧密相关，作品亦承载了特定情境下的情志与感怀。
en_translation: I roll up the crimson blind.
Morning rain and light clouds have just lifted.
Beyond the railing,
mist-willows dance in clearing light,
sweet grass creeps up the steps against red peonies.
The east wind, jealous of flowers, is cruel.
It blows down petals from the withered boughs,
tender buds from the branch tips.
Folding screens drawn close,
agarwood incense smoulders, weary,
and a hung-over heart shrinks from wine cups.
I recall the old capital, Luoyang.
Then young and wild,
lost in song and laughter.
Fine horses and lacquered carriages hastened our toilette.
We rode together on the imperial road,
walked hand in hand through Shanglin Park,
and made trysts soon after Lantern Festival ended.
How could I have believed I would drift a stranger now?
Everything feels so lonely and forlorn.
I think of all the pleasures we knew.
Powder scent has faded from my robe,
letters are broken, strings unstrung.
Jade branches and moon-like pearls — spring still as yesterday.
Grieving, after parting, before the Huabiao pillar,
when will those twin cranes return?
This longing — unless
I drown it in wine, how can I even briefly forget?
baihua_lines: 早晨的细雨轻阴刚刚停歇。
芳草蔓上台阶映衬着红芍药。
东风妒忌花开，心肠凶恶。
醉酒后的心情怕见杯勺。
骏马香车催促着梳妆出发。
灯节刚过就早早定下约会。
又怎能相信如今漂泊他乡。
可叹粉香已在衣襟上淡褪，
琼枝璧月般的春色还如昨日。
向醉乡里、才能暂时忘却。
baihua: 卷起朱红色的帘子。早晨的细雨轻阴刚刚停歇。栏杆之外，烟柳在晴光中摇曳，芳草蔓上台阶映衬着红芍药。东风妒忌花开，心肠凶恶。吹落了梢头的嫩花萼。屏风掩着，沉香疲倦地熏着，醉酒后的心情怕见杯勺。回想旧日的京洛。正值年少疏狂，在歌声欢笑中沉迷。骏马香车催促着梳妆出发。曾在驰道上同车共载，在上林苑携手同游，灯节刚过就早早定下约会。又怎能相信如今漂泊他乡。寂寞啊。追忆往日的行乐。可叹粉香已在衣襟上淡褪，音书断绝、琴弦也散落。琼枝璧月般的春色还如昨日。惆怅别后华表柱前，那双鹤何时归来。相思之情除非是，向醉乡里、才能暂时忘却。

title: 石州慢
author: 张元干
note: 【石州慢】张元干所作的词。【张元干】张元干（1091—约1161），字仲宗，号芦川居士，长乐人。南宋初期爱国词人，词风豪迈苍凉，为辛派词人先驱。
tr: 寒水依痕，春意渐回，沙际烟阔。溪梅晴照生香，冷芯数枝争发。天涯旧恨，试看几许消魂，长亭门外山重叠。不尽眼中青，是愁来时节。情切。画楼深闭，想见东风，暗销肌雪。辜负枕前云雨，尊前花月。心期切处，更有多少凄凉，殷勤留与归时说。到得却相逢，恰经年离别。
appr: 《石州慢》是宋代张元干的一首词，词作长短句错落，音韵婉转，善于抒写幽微深挚的情感。开篇以“寒水依痕”起笔，直陈情境，开门见山切入主题，为全篇奠定情感基调。诗人将羁旅漂泊之感与对故乡的思念融入景物描写之中，不事雕琢而真情流露。结句以“恰经年离别”收束全篇，点明题旨、呼应开篇，情韵悠长，给读者留下无尽回味。整首词语言凝练、意境深远，充分体现了张元干词创作的独特艺术风貌。

theme: 《石州慢》是宋代张元干的代表作品，全诗抒发羁旅漂泊的孤独与对故乡亲人的思念，道出游子的深沉乡愁。作品以凝练的语言、鲜明的意象，将真挚情感寄寓于写景、叙事与抒情之中，以“恰经年离别”收束，含蓄深沉、韵味悠长，在艺术上达到情景交融的境界，是张元干词创作中颇具特色的佳作。
en_body: Cold water lingers on old sand marks, spring feeling gradually returns, across the sandy shore mist spreads wide. Streamside plums breathe fragrance in clear sunlight, amid cold scent a few branches race to bloom. Old sorrows of wanderings at world's end — see how much heart-break there is beyond the Long Pavilion gate in folding hills. Endless green before the eyes, and this is when grief comes. Deep and true the feeling. Painted towers closed fast, I picture her in the east wind, snow-white skin quietly melting away. I have betrayed the cloud-and-rain love before the pillow, and the flower-moon evenings before the wine. Where the heart's hope was keenest, how much desolation lingers, kept carefully to tell when I return. When at last we meet again, it will have been exactly a year of separation.

试看有多少令人销魂之事，
她肌肤上的白雪暗自销融。

en_body: Orioles cry among willows at dawn, breaking my first dream. Fragrant mist seeps through the curtain, clear and cold. Rouge lightly applied, her palace-style makeup elegant, like Wenjun of old — still faint with spring wine. Her tender heart graceful and yielding, her lovely bearing poised and free, peach and plum blossoms fall mute before her. Xiangru's spring longing winds unceasingly. Helpless against this flower-cherishing love. Deep within the winding rail and small balustrade, he earnestly shelters her delicate form. Famous peonies — the Yao yellow, the Wei purple, though their colours are at their height, cannot match her lightness and grace.

en_translation: Orioles cry among willows at dawn, breaking my first dream.
Fragrant mist seeps through the curtain, clear and cold.
Rouge lightly applied, her palace-style makeup elegant,
like Wenjun of old — still faint with spring wine.
Her tender heart graceful and yielding,
her lovely bearing poised and free,
peach and plum blossoms fall mute before her.
Xiangru's spring longing winds unceasingly.
Helpless against this flower-cherishing love.
Deep within the winding rail and small balustrade,
he earnestly shelters her delicate form.
Famous peonies — the Yao yellow, the Wei purple,
though their colours are at their height,
cannot match her lightness and grace.

就像卓文君、还带着春日的醉意。
桃花李花在她面前都黯然失声。
司马相如的春思正绵绵萦绕。
奈何心中满是惜花深情。
殷勤为她、遮护娉婷的身影。
姚黄魏紫这样的牡丹名品，
终究比不上她轻盈灵动。

en_body: A few calls of the cuckoo. Announcing once more the end of blossoms. Grieving for spring I break a withered spray. Rain falls light, the wind blows fierce, in the season of green unripe plums. That willow of Yongfang, heeded by no one, all day sends catkins flying like snow. Do not pluck the thinnest string, for at the height of grief the string itself will speak. Heaven never grows old, and love is hard to sever. The heart is like a net woven of double thread, filled with a thousand thousand knots. The night has passed, yet east window still dark, a waning moon hangs low.

en_body: A mournful zither plays the Xiang River tune, note after note paints the green waves of Xiang. Slender fingers on the thirteen strings, delivering a deep, unspoken grief. Before the feast her eyes, like autumn water, they move slowly past with heavy tread, the jade bridges slanting like wild geese in flight. When the playing reaches the heart-breaking part, her spring-mountain brows sink low. Drunk, I let my whip hang, Zhang Xian: twin butterflies embroidered on her silk skirt, we first met at the Eastern Pond feast. Rouge and powder but lightly laid, like wild flowers holding a faint spring. Carefully, carefully she threads her needle, gazing, she is lovely in every part, all praise — her waist slender as a willow. Yesterday, when mountains blurred in dusk, she came with cloud from the hills still on her clothes.

baihua_lines: 哀怨的筝声弹起《湘江曲》，
一声声写尽湘江碧波绿。
纤细的手指抚弄十三根琴弦，
细细将幽深的愁恨传出。
酒筵前她的双眸如秋水般
玉柱排列如斜飞的雁行。
她春山般的眉黛低低垂落。
如野花般带着淡淡春色。
细，此情此景令人心生感慨。
人人都称道、柳一般的细腰。
来的时候衣上还沾着山间云气。

en_body: Just turning warm, still a little chill, wind and rain settled only at dusk. The courtyard is still, as Qingming draws near, drunk before withered blossoms, the same old sickness as last year returns. title: 六州歌头
author: 张孝祥
note: 【六州歌头】张孝祥所作的词。【张孝祥】张孝祥（1132—1170），字安国，号于湖居士，历阳乌江人。南宋爱国词人，词风豪迈飘逸，近苏轼，其《六州歌头》忠愤填膺

en_body: Gazing into the distance as far as the eye can see, the frontier lies flat and vast. Dust of expedition darkens the air, frost winds bite sharp, border sounds fall still. I am lost in bitter gloom. Recalling the catastrophe of those years, perhaps it was heaven's will, not the work of men, by the Zhu and Si rivers, once the land of strings and songs, now reeking of barbarian stench. Across the water lies a land of felt tents, at sunset cattle and sheep return, enemy outposts criss-cross everywhere. See enemy princes hunting by night, their cavalry fires lighting the whole plain. Reed pipes and war drums sound mournful and bold. It makes one tremble. I think of the arrows at my waist, the sword in its case, caked in dust and moth-eaten in vain, what deed can they achieve? Time slips easily away, a bold heart is in vain, the years draw to a close. The sacred capital is far, out of sight. The court appeases with dance and plumes, beacon fires are stilled, arms are laid aside. Envoys in their carriages and caps rush back and forth in swarms, a sight to make one ashamed. They say the survivors in the central plain gaze ever southward, hoping for our imperial banners and carriage. If a traveller should come to this place, righteous anger would fill his breast, and his tears pour down like rain.

en_body: Dongting Lake and Qingcao Lake joined as one, near Mid-Autumn, not a breath of wind. Thirty thousand qing of jade-mirror and jasper fields, bearing my single leaf of a boat. The pale moon pours its light in every quarter, the Milky Way shares its image with the waves, within and without, all crystal clear. In quiet ease my heart perceives a wonder too fine to tell you. I think of the year spent by the southern seas, the solitary moon lighting me, my lungs and liver as pure as ice and snow. Short hair sparse, my sleeves and collar cold, I float steady on the vast and empty waves. I will drink the West River dry, pour carefully from the Northern Dipper as my cup, and invite all creation to be my guest. Tapping the gunwale I laugh alone, not knowing what night, what year, this is.

appreciation: 《念奴娇》是宋代张孝祥所作的词名篇。全诗共八句，为律诗体裁，格律严谨、对仗工稳。首联起笔点题，颔联、颈联铺陈对仗，尾联收束点明旨意。章法井然，音韵和谐。艺术上，作品善于选取典型意象融情于景，用词精炼传神，于平淡处见深情，读来余韵悠长。作为宋代诗歌的经典篇章，《念奴娇》历代传诵不衰，是张孝祥诗歌风格的集中体现。
structure:
【起·首联】一二句起笔点题，交代时地、情境与情感基调。
【承·颔联】三四句承接铺陈，对仗工整，拓展意境。
【转·颈联】五六句笔锋一转，由景入情或由外入内，翻出新意。
【合·尾联】七八句收束全诗，点明主旨，呼应开篇。
imagery:
【月】月亮意象，常寄托思乡、怀人、孤寂之意，亦象征高洁、永恒。

【江】流水意象，喻时光流逝、离愁绵长，亦指壮阔胸怀。

【风】风意象，春风主喜乐，秋风主悲愁，东风送春，西风送秋。

【草】草意象，春草生意，秋草萧瑟，常喻离愁与岁月。

【舟】舟船意象，喻行旅漂泊、归隐江湖。

诸意象交织呼应，共同构成完整的意境整体，使抽象情感具象可感。
background: 《念奴娇》为宋代张孝祥所作。宋代诗歌重理趣、好议论，以文为诗，苏轼、黄庭坚、陆游、杨万里等大家辈出；宋词更是一代之文学，婉约豪放各臻其妙。作者张孝祥在这一时期的创作，多与其人生际遇、时代背景紧密相关，作品亦承载了特定情境下的情志与感怀。
en_translation: Dongting Lake and Qingcao Lake joined as one,
near Mid-Autumn, not a breath of wind.
Thirty thousand qing of jade-mirror and jasper fields,
bearing my single leaf of a boat.
The pale moon pours its light in every quarter,
the Milky Way shares its image with the waves,
within and without, all crystal clear.
In quiet ease my heart perceives
a wonder too fine to tell you.
I think of the year spent by the southern seas,
the solitary moon lighting me,
my lungs and liver as pure as ice and snow.
Short hair sparse, my sleeves and collar cold,
I float steady on the vast and empty waves.
I will drink the West River dry,
pour carefully from the Northern Dipper as my cup,
and invite all creation to be my guest.
Tapping the gunwale I laugh alone,
not knowing what night, what year, this is.
baihua_lines: 临近中秋、没有一丝风色。
如玉镜琼田般的湖面三万顷，
天上银河与湖面共留月影，
这美妙之处难以对你说清。
应感念在岭南海畔度过了一年，
肝肺都像冰雪般晶莹高洁。
短发稀疏、衣襟两袖清冷，
安稳地泛舟于沧浪空阔的江面。
baihua: 洞庭湖与青草湖相连，临近中秋、没有一丝风色。如玉镜琼田般的湖面三万顷，载着我的一叶扁舟。皎洁的月亮分洒清辉，天上银河与湖面共留月影，里外上下都澄澈透明。悠然间心领神会，这美妙之处难以对你说清。应感念在岭南海畔度过了一年，孤月光照自我，肝肺都像冰雪般晶莹高洁。短发稀疏、衣襟两袖清冷，安稳地泛舟于沧浪空阔的江面。尽吸西江之水为酒，细斟北斗七星为酒杯，请来天地万物做宾客。扣着船舷独自大笑，不知今夜是何年何夕。

title: 烛影摇红
author: 张抡
note: 【烛影摇红】张抡所作的词。【张抡】张抡，字才甫，号莲社居士，开封人。南宋词人，约宋高宗绍兴中前后在世。
tr: 双阙中天，凤楼十二春寒浅。去年元夜奉宸游，曾侍瑶池宴。玉殿珠帘尽卷。拥群仙、蓬壶阆苑。五云深处，万烛光中，揭天丝管。驰隙流年，恍如一瞬星霜换。今宵谁念泣孤臣，回首长安远。可是尘缘未断。谩惆怅、华胥梦短。满怀幽恨，数点寒灯，几声归雁。
appr: 《烛影摇红》是宋代张抡的一首词，词作长短句错落，音韵婉转，善于抒写幽微深挚的情感。开篇以“双阙中天”起笔，直陈情境，开门见山切入主题，为全篇奠定情感基调。结句以“几声归雁”收束全篇，点明题旨、呼应开篇，情韵悠长，给读者留下无尽回味。整首词语言凝练、意境深远，充分体现了张抡词创作的独特艺术风貌。
st:
【起】开篇“双阙中天”，起笔入题，勾勒场景、渲染氛围，定下全词情感基调。
【承】“五云深处”一句承接铺叙，层层延展，将情境与情绪推进深化。
【转】至“回首长安远”处笔锋一转，或由今忆昔、或由景入情，词意翻进，情感达到高潮。
【合】结拍“几声归雁”，以景结情或以情结景，收束题旨，余韵不尽，耐人回味。

【雁】雁鸿意象，古有雁足传书之说，代指音信，亦写羁旅思乡。

【云】云意象，或舒或卷，象征漂泊无定、隐逸自在，烘托悠远意境。

【霜】霜意象，象征肃杀凄凉、岁月蹉跎与白发迟暮。

【春】春意象，象征美好、生机与希望，也常反衬愁绪与伤春之情。

en_body: Twin palace towers pierce the sky, twelve phoenix pavilions hold a faint spring chill. Last year on Lantern Festival I attended the imperial procession, and served at the Jasper Pool feast. Pearl blinds of the jade hall were rolled up high. Immortals thronged, as in the fairy realms of Penglai and Langyuan. Deep in five-coloured auspicious clouds, amid ten thousand candle flames, silk and pipe music rose to heaven. The flowing years gallop past like a pony past a crack, and in a flash stars and frost have changed their places. Tonight who thinks of this lone servant weeping, looking back to Chang'an so far away? And yet my worldly ties are not yet broken. In vain I grieve — the dream of Huaxu was too short. My breast full of deep unspoken rancour, a few cold lamps flicker, and returning geese cry out a few times.

baihua_lines: 去年元宵之夜陪侍帝王巡游，
玉殿的珠帘全都高高卷起。
簇拥着群仙般的嫔妃、仿佛在蓬壶阆苑仙境。
恍惚一瞬之间星霜岁月已换。
今夜谁会顾念我这个孤臣垂泪，
可是尘缘终究未能断绝。
徒然惆怅、华胥美梦太短。

title: 八声甘州
author: 张炎
note: 【八声甘州】张炎所作的词。【张炎】张炎（1248—约1320），字叔夏，号玉田，临安人。南宋末年著名词人、词论家，宋亡后流落不偶，词风清空骚雅，著《词源》

en_body: Facing yellow chrysanthemums still blooming across the yard, what resentment that the Double Ninth has passed? Leaning on the rail, my drunken sleeve in the wind, the lingering evening sun stirs cold chrysanthemum scent. I sigh over a lifetime of wild freedom, thousands of songs and laughter. White hair assailed me early, thick as clear frost. Who would believe my heart is now all indolence, finding comfort in Buddhist shrines and Daoist cells, yellow scrolls and a monk's bed by the dim lamp. All the dalliance with rouge and powder, tossed away to the land of fragrant grass. Someone calls you — return to the Eastern Hills, lamps are lit, beside pine gates and bamboo fences. Shut the door and sleep, let people say what they will, what matter if I am slow and foolish?

background: 《八声甘州》为宋代张炎所作。宋代诗歌重理趣、好议论，以文为诗，苏轼、黄庭坚、陆游、杨万里等大家辈出；宋词更是一代之文学，婉约豪放各臻其妙。作者张炎在这一时期的创作，多与其人生际遇、时代背景紧密相关，作品亦承载了特定情境下的情志与感怀。
en_translation: Facing yellow chrysanthemums still blooming across the yard,
what resentment that the Double Ninth has passed?
Leaning on the rail, my drunken sleeve in the wind,
the lingering evening sun
stirs cold chrysanthemum scent.
I sigh over a lifetime of wild freedom,
thousands of songs and laughter.
White hair assailed me early,
thick as clear frost.
Who would believe my heart is now all indolence,
finding comfort in Buddhist shrines and Daoist cells,
yellow scrolls and a monk's bed by the dim lamp.
All the dalliance with rouge and powder,
tossed away to the land of fragrant grass.
Someone calls you — return to the Eastern Hills,
lamps are lit, beside pine gates and bamboo fences.
Shut the door and sleep,
let people say what they will,
what matter if I am slow and foolish?

title: 月下笛
author: 张炎
note: 【月下笛】张炎所作的词。【张炎】张炎（1248—约1320），字叔夏，号玉田，临安人。南宋末年著名词人、词论家，宋亡后流落不偶，词风清空骚雅，著《词源》
tr: 万里孤云，清游渐远，故人何处。寒窗梦里，犹记经行旧时路。连昌约略无多柳，第一是、难听夜雨。谩惊回凄悄，相看烛影，拥衾谁语。张绪。归何暮。半零落，依依断桥鸥鹭。天涯倦旅。此时心事良苦。只愁重洒西州泪，问杜曲、人家在否。恐翠袖、正天寒，犹倚梅花那树。
appr: 《月下笛》是宋代张炎的一首词，词作长短句错落，音韵婉转，善于抒写幽微深挚的情感。开篇以“万里孤云”起笔，直陈情境，开门见山切入主题，为全篇奠定情感基调。诗人将羁旅漂泊之感与对故乡的思念融入景物描写之中，不事雕琢而真情流露。结句以“犹倚梅花那树”收束全篇，点明题旨、呼应开篇，情韵悠长，给读者留下无尽回味。整首词语言凝练、意境深远，充分体现了张炎词创作的独特艺术风貌。

theme: 《月下笛》是宋代张炎的代表作品，全诗抒发羁旅漂泊的孤独与对故乡亲人的思念，道出游子的深沉乡愁。作品以凝练的语言、鲜明的意象，将真挚情感寄寓于写景、叙事与抒情之中，以“犹倚梅花那树”收束，含蓄深沉、韵味悠长，在艺术上达到情景交融的境界，是张炎词创作中颇具特色的佳作。
en_body: A lone cloud across ten thousand li of sky, my carefree wandering carries me further, where are my old friends now? In dreams by the cold window, I still recall the roads we walked together. Even Lianchang Palace can have few willows left, worst of all — I cannot bear the sound of night rain. Wakened in vain to cold silence, facing the candle's shadow, clutching my quilt — with whom can I speak? Zhang Xu of those days. Why do I return so late in life? Half of everything has withered away, gulls and herons lingering by the broken bridge. A weary traveller at the edge of the world. My heart's burden at this hour is heavy indeed. I fear I shall shed Xizhou tears again, and I ask — are those houses of Duqu still standing? I fear the beauty in green sleeves, in this cold, still leans on that same plum tree.

title: 渡江云
author: 张炎

en_body: Mountains bare, sky pouring into the sea, I lean from the tower and gaze my fill, the wind is sharp, evening tides beginning to rise. Beyond the blind, a shower amid turtledove calls, a few idle fields, across the water spring hoes are already moving. Fresh smoke, willows of the forbidden quarter, I think by now — the green has reached West Lake. I still remember — those years of deep seclusion, gate half-closed, two or three willows beside the door. All sorrow rests heavy upon my weary heart. Deserted islets, ancient fords, a life of broken stems and drifting duckweed, where more shall I be washed? In vain I feel — my belt grows loose as I waste away, my shadow shy, the lamp a lonely thing. I always thought to see that peach-blossom face again soon, why of late — even laughter comes with no letter? Letters may travel far, but how can there be none at all?

In vain I feel — my belt grows loose as I waste away,
my shadow shy, the lamp a lonely thing.
I always thought to see that peach-blossom face again soon,
why of late — even laughter comes with no letter?
Letters may travel far,
but how can there be none at all?
baihua_lines: 隔水已经有人挥动春锄。
想如今、绿色已经染到西湖。
还记得、当年深居隐居时，
院门轻掩，门旁有两三株柳树。
荒凉的小洲、古老的渡口，
空自觉得、腰围消瘦衣带渐减，
顾影自怜，对灯也觉孤独。
常以为很快就能见到桃花般的容颜，
为什么近来、反而笑说音书全无。
baihua: 山色空蒙，天容入海，倚楼极目远眺，风急晚潮初涨。帘外斑鸠声里一阵雨，几处闲置的水田，隔水已经有人挥动春锄。新烟初生，禁苑的柳树，想如今、绿色已经染到西湖。还记得、当年深居隐居时，院门轻掩，门旁有两三株柳树。忧愁啊。荒凉的小洲、古老的渡口，断梗飘萍般的身世，还能漂流向何处。空自觉得、腰围消瘦衣带渐减，顾影自怜，对灯也觉孤独。常以为很快就能见到桃花般的容颜，为什么近来、反而笑说音书全无。纵使书信遥远，怎么会连一封都没有。
en_lines: Mountains bare, sky pouring into the sea,
I lean from the tower and gaze my fill,
the wind is sharp, evening tides beginning to rise.
Beyond the blind, a shower amid turtledove calls,
a few idle fields,
across the water spring hoes are already moving.
Fresh smoke, willows of the forbidden quarter,
I think by now — the green has reached West Lake.
I still remember — those years of deep seclusion,
gate half-closed, two or three willows beside the door.
All sorrow rests heavy upon my weary heart.
Deserted islets, ancient fords,
a life of broken stems and drifting duckweed,
where more shall I be washed?
In vain I feel — my belt grows loose as I waste away,
my shadow shy, the lamp a lonely thing.
I always thought to see that peach-blossom face again soon,
why of late — even laughter comes with no letter?
Letters may travel far,
but how can there be none at all?
